nodes.label: Cash Landrum
nodes.full_label: Cash Landrum
nodes.catchy_title: Why the Cash Landrum Case Still Defies Resolution
nodes.summary: The Cash–Landrum UFO incident was a reported close encounter on 29 December 1980 near Huffman, Texas, involving Betty Cash, Vickie Landrum and Landrum’s seven-year-old grandson, Colby. They said a brilliant, diamond-shaped object hovered over a rural road, emitted intense heat and flame, and was later accompanied by numerous military-style helicopters.
